ID: `jado-motion`.

## What it does

Distinguishes opportunities, specification, implementation and review. Connects relevant skills to the purpose and stack, keeping reduced motion, interruptions and evidence explicit.

## When to use it

When deciding where motion helps, building a transition or assessing existing animations.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-motion` in Claude Code or `$jado-motion` in Codex. Specify the phase, interaction, expected frequency, stack and scope. Visual can handle specification only; Frontend implements. review-animations requires explicit user invocation.

## What it delivers

- Specification with triggers, states and criteria, or reasons to avoid motion
- Implementation only if assigned
- Behavior and performance evidence, with stated limitations

## Example

Specify save feedback and implement it using existing primitives, also checking reduced motion and repeated actions.
